data.location: 775 Main Street South, Southbury, CT (Southbury Green shopping center)
data.short_description: Mediterranean restaurant (NJ-based chain; first CT location) serving kebabs, shawarma, Turkish cuisine, falafel, gyro, moussaka, flatbreads, fish, and more. Open Thu 10am–11pm.
Relocating from The Plaza at Buckland Hills; new ~12,000 sq ft space near Savers and US Furniture. Renovation underway. No opening date announced.
Cat cafe offering coffee, tea, small bites, and cats available for adoption in partnership with Enfield Community Cat Project.
Location open for nearly two decades; previously a Roy Rogers. Arby's now has 4 CT locations remaining (Waterbury, North Haven, Danbury, Plantsville).

data.store_name: Josephs on Whitney by Chef Mickey
data.short_description: Neighborhood bistro & bar featuring Mediterranean and American menu (steaks, lamb chops, salmon, pastas). Chef Mickey Joseph's return to CT. Hours: Mon–Sat, doors open 4pm; closed Sundays.
Halal cuisine restaurant serving over-rice platters, gyros, burgers, wings, ice cream, and milkshakes. Sun–Thu 12pm–11pm; Fri–Sat 12pm–2am.
